basic_details.job_title: ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 78 Junior Resident, Professor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Medical College and Hospital Andheri (ESIC Andheri) is recruiting candidates for 78 vacancies across Professor (16), Associate Professor (21), Assistant Professor (11), Senior Resident (21), and Junior Resident (9) posts on a contract basis under advertisement number 13/2026. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview from 26 October 2026 to 28 October 2026, with reporting scheduled at 9:30 AM. Qualifications vary by post, requiring NMC norms for faculty and senior posts, and an MBBS with a completed internship for Junior Residents, carrying corresponding pay amounts such as Rs.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies and original versions of the following documents: Certificate of passing class 10th for Date of Birth All Marks sheets, Attempt, and Degree Certificate of MBBS All Marks sheets, Attempt, and Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/Other examination Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD Certificate issued in format for Central Govt. job, wherever applicable State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of Publication(s) Experience Certificate Recent Passport Size Photograph Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current Employer, if applicable Aadhar Card Completion Certificate of ICMR/NMC approved basic Course in Biomedical Research, if any NMC approved revised basic course workshop/Basic Course in Medical Education workshop Certificate, if any Demand Draft as Interview Fee, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance of candidates in the interview before the selection board. In case the turnout of candidates for Senior Resident (Dental) and Junior Resident posts is more than 30, the competent authority at their discretion shall conduct a screening test consisting of multiple-choice questions in the concerned discipline and ESIC-related topics to shortlist up to three times candidates per vacancy in order of merit.

Candidates working in Govt./Autonomous/Statutory Institutions should preferably bring an NOC from their employer. The upper age limit, tenure, and reservations are governed by Government of India and NMC guidelines. In the event suitable reserved category candidates are not available, posts may be filled by candidates from other categories on a purely temporary contract basis for 44 days.

faq.question: Q1. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled from 26 October 2026 to 28 October 2026, with reporting time from 09:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the walk-in interviews take place?
faq.answer: The interviews will be held at the Office of the Dean, 5th Floor, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Central Road, MIDC, Opposite MIDC Police Station, Andheri (East), Mumbai – 400093.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 78 vacancies across Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident, and Junior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a completed internship on or before the date of the interview, along with an updated medical registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Senior Resident posts is not exceeding 45 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee, and how should it be paid?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for UR/OBC/EWS candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favor of ESI Fund Account No. 1, payable at Mumbai. SC/ST, ESIC regular employees, female candidates, ex-servicemen, and PH candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These posts are on a contractual basis for a period of one year, extendable up to three years for teaching faculty and senior residents, and one year only for junior residents.

faq.question: Q8. Will allowances be paid on top of the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, other allowances include DA, NPA, TA, HRA, etc., as per official pay rules.

faq.question: Q9. What selection criteria are used if candidate turnout is high?
faq.answer: If the turnout of candidates for Senior Resident (Dental) and Junior Resident posts exceeds 30, a screening test consisting of multiple-choice questions will be conducted to shortlist candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, 10th pass certificate for DOB, MBBS and postgraduate degree mark sheets and certificates, valid category certificates, updated medical registration, Aadhar card, publications, experience certificates, and passport-size photographs along with original copies.
